visual_action: The video first shows Donald Trump in a crowded restaurant, gesturing and speaking. It then cuts to Joe Biden in an ice cream shop, wearing sunglasses and holding up a Dairy Queen Blizzard cup upside down.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown on screen speaking in the first half of the video.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: He is shown on screen in the second half of the video, and is referenced in the on-screen text as 'Dark Brandon'.

on_screen_text.text: What the hell is a blizzard?

spoken_summary: Donald Trump says, "Everybody wants a blizzard," and then asks, "What the hell is a blizzard?"
audio_music: The first half features dialogue and crowd noise. When the video cuts to Joe Biden, a hip-hop/trap beat ('Delivery' by Dbow) begins, creating a confident and 'cool' mood.
editing_pacing: A single, quick cut juxtaposing a clip of Donald Trump with a clip of Joe Biden.
central_claim: The video contrasts Donald Trump's apparent confusion over a Dairy Queen Blizzard with Joe Biden's cool handling of one to portray Trump as out of touch and Biden as competent and relatable.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump as out of touch and promote Joe Biden as cool and competent using the 'Dark Brandon' meme.
